Open the Swiggy app and make sure you are logged in on the account you will order from.
Tap the offer link above, preferably on your phone so it opens inside the Swiggy app.
Pick the offer you want (morning, night, weekend or payday cash) and activate or claim it.
Add food or Instamart items to your cart and check that the offer shows as applied before paying.
Complete the order. If the discount does not show, check the offer terms or try the next link.

Try each link one by one and pick the one that gives you the best saving on your order.
Combine with your bank or card offers at payment, if Swiggy allows it for that order.
Do not pay anyone for “offer codes”. Real Swiggy offers only come from the Swiggy app or its official pages.
